KaTeX/MathLive compatibility font template notice

The MathLive 0.110.0 KaTeX-compatible font templates used by this repository
contain the following upstream metadata:

Copyright (c) 2009-2010, Design Science, Inc. (<www.mathjax.org>)
Copyright (c) 2014-2018 Khan Academy (<www.khanacademy.org>)

The template metadata declares these Reserved Font Names:

KaTeX_AMS
KaTeX_Caligraphic
KaTeX_Fraktur
KaTeX_Main
KaTeX_Math
KaTeX_SansSerif
KaTeX_Script
KaTeX_Size1
KaTeX_Size2
KaTeX_Size3
KaTeX_Size4
KaTeX_Typewriter

The template metadata states:

This Font Software is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
This license available with a FAQ at:
http://scripts.sil.org/OFL

The complete SIL Open Font License 1.1 terms are included in OFL.txt. The
adapter does not redistribute the template font outlines. It uses their cmap
and metric information for MathLive 0.110.0 interoperability.

To preserve the declared Reserved Font Names, the delivered adapter binaries
use internal primary family names beginning with “Excalifont Extended ML”. The KaTeX_*
strings remain only as MathLive-required CSS aliases, filenames, manifest
keys, and font-map compatibility identifiers.
